label: Thyroid Cancer Cases (Fukushima Cohort)
contestNote: 2024 Lancet cohort study found no statistical association between radiation exposure (>99.9% of cases <5 mSv) and thyroid cancer detection. Most epidemiologists attribute to screening effect. Debate continues.

label: Est. Total Decommissioning Cost
source: METI Nuclear Damage Liability Facilitation Fund (2016 revised estimate)
contestNote: Some independent analyses estimate total societal costs including compensation, reconstruction, and foregone energy at ¥50–70 trillion ($450–630B)

label: Estimated Melted Fuel Debris (Units 1–3)
source: TEPCO / IRID — 0.7g retrieved in trial (Nov 2024); Unit 1 full-scale rubble removal began June 22, 2026
contestNote: Only 0.7 grams of fuel debris retrieved so far (Nov 2024 trial). Full-scale removal of ~1,200 tonnes of rubble from Unit 1's reactor building top floor began June 22, 2026, a prerequisite for eventual spent fuel pool access. TEPCO also began transferring Unit 2's 615 spent fuel assemblies out of its pool on June 2, 2026 (separate from fuel debris retrieval). Unit 3 requires 12–15 years preparation before full-scale debris work. A July 25, 2026 Asahi Shimbun report found overall site radioactive waste could reach 5.6 million m³ (vs. TEPCO's 800,000 m³ estimate) without volume-reduction measures, and that a planned metal-melting facility has slipped 3 years to FY2032–2034.

label: Disaster-Related Deaths (Fukushima Pref.)
deltaNote: Deaths caused by evacuation stress, inadequate medical care, suicide; exceeds direct tsunami/earthquake deaths in Fukushima. No direct radiation deaths confirmed.
